<documents>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="travel-blocked-regions">
Countriesˆwhereˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆTallowbrookˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆinˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆandˆregions.ˆPurchases,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆonlineˆordersˆfromˆmerchantsˆbasedˆthereˆareˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆWhyˆUSˆbanksˆandˆcardˆprogramsˆmustˆfollowˆUSˆsanctionsˆrules.ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptions,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆunblockˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆSigningˆinˆfromˆabroadˆYouˆcanˆusuallyˆuseˆtheˆappˆfromˆanywhere,ˆbutˆaccessˆfromˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆmayˆbeˆblockedˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆDeclinedˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆaˆcountryˆthatˆisn'tˆsanctionedˆandˆyourˆcardˆisˆdeclined,ˆtheˆcauseˆisˆmoreˆlikelyˆaˆfraudˆcheck,ˆyourˆcardˆcontrols,ˆorˆyourˆbalance.ˆSeeˆ"Whyˆwasˆmyˆcardˆdeclined?".ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆabroadˆInternationalˆwiresˆtoˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆareˆalsoˆblocked.ˆWiresˆtoˆotherˆcountriesˆmayˆstillˆbeˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="travel-exchange-rates">
ExchangeˆratesˆweˆuseˆWhenˆyouˆpayˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆweˆconvertˆtheˆamountˆtoˆUSˆdollarsˆusingˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆexchangeˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles.ˆWeˆdon'tˆaddˆaˆmarkupˆtoˆthatˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆpayˆonˆtopˆYourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆaddedˆasˆaˆpercentageˆofˆtheˆconvertedˆamount:ˆ-ˆBasic:ˆ3%ˆ-ˆPlus:ˆ1%ˆ-ˆPremium:ˆ0%ˆ##ˆWhyˆtheˆamountˆchangesˆAˆpendingˆtransactionˆshowsˆanˆestimateˆbasedˆonˆtheˆrateˆwhenˆyouˆpaid.ˆTheˆfinalˆamountˆusesˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles,ˆusuallyˆaˆdayˆorˆtwoˆlater,ˆsoˆitˆcanˆmoveˆslightlyˆupˆorˆdown.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrencyˆIfˆaˆforeignˆmerchantˆrefundsˆyou,ˆweˆconvertˆtheˆrefundˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆThatˆcanˆbeˆaˆlittleˆmoreˆorˆlessˆthanˆyouˆoriginallyˆpaid.ˆWeˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆpart.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆtoˆpurchasesˆmadeˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆandˆtoˆpurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUS.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
